entries.title: Job 28:1
segments: ¶Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold which they refine;

entries.title: Job 28:2
segments: Iron is taken out of the dust, and copper is molten out of the stone.

entries.title: Job 28:3
segments: [Man] putteth an end to the darkness, and exploreth to the utmost limit, the stones of darkness and of the shadow of death.

entries.title: Job 28:4
segments: He openeth a shaft far from the inhabitants [of the earth]: forgotten of the foot, they hang suspended; away below men they hover.

entries.title: Job 28:5
segments: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread, and underneath it is turned up as by fire;

entries.title: Job 28:6
segments: The stones of it are the place of sapphires, and it hath dust of gold.

entries.title: Job 28:7
segments: It is a path no bird of prey knoweth, and the vulture's eye hath not seen it;

entries.title: Job 28:8
segments: The proud beasts have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed over it.

entries.title: Job 28:9
segments: [Man] putteth forth his hand upon the flinty rock, he overturneth the mountains by the root.

entries.title: Job 28:10
segments: He cutteth out channels in the rocks, and his eye seeth every precious thing.

entries.title: Job 28:11
segments: He bindeth the streams that they drip not, and what is hidden he bringeth forth to light.

entries.title: Job 28:12
segments: But wisdom, where shall it be found? and where is the place of understanding?

entries.title: Job 28:13
segments: Man knoweth not the value thereof; and it is not found in the land of the living.

entries.title: Job 28:14
segments: ¶The deep saith, It is not in me; and the sea saith, It is not with me.

entries.title: Job 28:15
segments: Choice gold cannot be given for it, nor silver be weighed for its price.

entries.title: Job 28:16
segments: It is not set in the balance with gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, and the sapphire.

entries.title: Job 28:17
segments: Gold and glass cannot be compared to it, nor vessels of fine gold be its exchange.

entries.title: Job 28:18
segments: Corals and crystal are no more remembered; yea, the acquisition of wisdom is above rubies.

entries.title: Job 28:19
segments: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not be compared to it, neither shall it be set in the balance with pure gold.

entries.title: Job 28:20
segments: ¶Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

entries.title: Job 28:21
segments: For it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and concealed from the fowl of the heavens.

entries.title: Job 28:22
segments: Destruction and death say, We have heard its report with our ears.

entries.title: Job 28:23
segments: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth its place:

entries.title: Job 28:24
segments: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, he seeth under the whole heaven.

entries.title: Job 28:25
segments: In making a weight for the wind, and meting out the waters by measure,

entries.title: Job 28:26
segments: In appointing a statute for the rain, and a way for the thunder's flash:

entries.title: Job 28:27
segments: Then did he see it, and declare it; he established it, yea, and searched it out;

entries.title: Job 28:28
segments: And unto man he said, Lo, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
